entry.title: New: Resolution 10 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
APPOINTS MEMBERS OF THE POLICY COMMITTEE ON PUBLIC WORKS AND MASS TRANSIT AND DESIGNATES THE CHAIRPERSON AND VICE CHAIRPERSON THEREOF

Designates Council Members James E. Hustace as Chairperson and Ashley L. Kierkiewicz as Vice Chairperson (remaining Council Members to serve as Members of this Committee).
